headline.text: Revenue growth is decelerating: guided 17.5% to 18.5% vs 21% reported
Management wording (confident vs cautious cues, -1..+1): prepared +0.33, qa +0.54

tone.method: lexical cue counts on management sentences; indicative of wording, not a measure of business health

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: The financial services landscape is becoming increasingly driven by investing.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We occupy the trusted center of the investing ecosystem.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We're both leading today and uniquely positioned to win in the future.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: There are several reasons for our confidence.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: First, our record results speak for themselves.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: As people increasingly consolidate their financial lives in one place and become even more engaged in investing, our unique combination of strengths puts us in the center of clients' financial lives.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We are innovating for clients at a rapid pace.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: In the second quarter of 2026, we delivered record results and growth on all fronts.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Managed investing net flows increased 53% over last year.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: All of this translated to record financial results.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We delivered $7.1 billion in total revenue and adjusted earnings per share of $1.62, up 42% over last year.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We are increasing our pace of innovation and adding to our breadth of capabilities as clients want to manage more of their financial life at Schwab.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We're delivering new products and solutions across our platform at a rapid pace.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Our Schwab Crypto rollout is going as planned, and we are on track to start piloting our crypto transfers capability by the end of this month.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We believe this capability creates an attractive M&A opportunity over time.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: When complete, we will be a premier destination for clients interested in investing in private markets, whether via a leading private manager, an index strategy, or investing directly in private companies.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We've added the ability to complete tax filings for clients through our third-party tax prep introduction program, and we've added to our banking capabilities, including the ability for clients to leverage private assets.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: With wealth.com, we'll expand our tax capabilities and introduce tax planning in addition to the insights we already provide today on client trusts.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We've made an investment in Paxos, a firm that is supporting the delivery of Schwab Crypto.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Client promoter scores are at all-time highs in both investor services and advisor services, all of which solidifies our role as the trusted platform of choice for investors and RIAs.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We have the most activity on our platform and are growing faster than our peers.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Our clients remain highly engaged, and we're continuing to invest to maintain our edge as the destination for traders.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Leadership at this scale creates advantages that compound over time.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We look to the future, there is a convergence of forces reshaping our industry, and we are uniquely positioned to lead.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: I discussed these trends at our Investor Day, and we continue to see them play out.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Households with $1 million-$5 million in assets using only one financial services firm jumped 11 percentage points year-over-year to 22%, and we expect this to grow as more investors seek the convenience of one-stop shopping in all aspects of their life.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: This consolidation is happening at a time when investing has never played a more important role in the broader financial ecosystem.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: As recently as a decade ago, investing skewed towards higher income, older, college-educated households.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: People are investing earlier in their life, and we're seeing engagement across a broader income and education spectrum.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Investing is playing an increasingly central role in people's financial lives.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: In a world where clients want to do more with one firm and investing is more important than ever, we are uniquely positioned at the center of the investing ecosystem with the ability to support the breadth of clients' needs in the channel of their choice and in the form they prefer.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: The RIAs we serve value our bank because they don't have to introduce another relationship to their clients.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We have the best trading platform in the industry, supported by industry-leading service as well as research, education, and coaching for traders of all sophistication levels.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We've launched crypto and are adding capabilities throughout the year.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Clients are turning to us because we simplify their financial life and help them achieve great outcomes across their investing, trading, wealth, banking, and lending needs.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: There are clearly pros and cons to tokenized securities, and it is unclear how much this market will take off, we're actively building the infrastructure to support client activity on the technology of clients' choice.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: With our product and capability breadth, combination of people and AI, and scale, we have a unique platform advantage that positions us to be the financial services provider of choice now and in the future, a position that is difficult for any competitor to match.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We're continuing to make investments that will support this growth in the future with more branches in local communities, more financial consultants, strategic marketing, and advertising, including adapting our marketing to the increased influence of large language models, the build-out of an RIA support ecosystem, and investments in bringing the breadth of Schwab to our workplace clients.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: First, our RIA business continues to grow at a record pace as more investors seek advice and guidance.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We see consistently strong growth in net flows to both our Schwab Advisor Network and flagship proprietary wealth offer, Schwab Wealth Advisory.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We're continuing to invest heavily in our Schwab Wealth Advisory offer, including in our tax, trust, and estate capabilities, to make sure we can meet the needs of retail clients that want more help and guidance in their life, and it is working.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: The U.S. retail market is $37 trillion and growing, and we have just 2% market share.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: The combination of the investments we're making in our wealth business, plus the sheer size of our self-directed investor base, creates an unmatched conversion funnel into advice that will delight clients, continue to fuel our growth, and diversify our economics over the long term.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Our bank is an important differentiator for us.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Our lending balances have increased 33% year over year, driven in large part by adoption of our digital Pledged Asset Line offer.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We're continuing to make investments to enhance our lending offers, including the addition of structured asset lending, which allows clients to leverage their private investments and private shares.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Our cost per account continues to decrease and our expense on client assets is the lowest in the industry.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We're investing in enhancing our AI experience, our global capabilities center, and our growth initiatives.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We've talked about AI as part of our omnichannel experience, it is becoming more embedded in all we do, accelerating our strategy and amplifying our competitive advantages by personalizing client experiences, enhancing productivity, and driving scalable growth.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Importantly, we believe our greatest advantage comes from combining people with AI-powered capabilities to create deeper relationships that scale with our clients' needs.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: AI will help us attract new clients, deliver new capabilities to them, personalize more journeys, and create more opportunities to deepen relationships over time.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We are making tangible progress here with the rollout of Portfolio Insights in May and the employee pilot for the first iteration of Schwab Assistant that launched earlier this month.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: With our combination of technology and people, our client ease scores are at or near all-time highs.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: 2Q was yet another strong quarter for Schwab, where the combination of our continued business momentum, client engagement, and diversified model enable us to deliver strong outcomes well beyond the second quarter scenario we shared with you at Investor Day in May.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: This outperformance was a result of a number of factors, including a further acceleration in client trading activity through the end of the quarter.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Total revenue grew 21% year-over-year to $7.1 billion, including a 19% increase in net interest revenue versus the prior year period due to increased utilization of our lending solutions by clients, the reduction of higher cost borrowings at the banks, and demand for long-short strategies.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Momentum within the technology sector helped lift equity markets to their best quarterly performance since early 2020, which in combination with robust asset gathering and client interest in Schwab's wealth and asset management offerings, drove 16% year-over-year growth in asset management and administration fees to $1.8 billion.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Bank deposit account fees grew 35% year-over-year due to continued improvement in the net yield, other revenue was up 32% versus 2Q 2025, with stronger trading volumes as well as typical second quarter seasonality.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Adjusted expenses for the second quarter grew 11% year-over-year, reflecting strong client engagement across our trading, wealth, and banking solutions, and the first full quarter of Forge, while underlying expenses remain in line with our initial expectations.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: We also continue to make investments in key strategic initiatives to support organic growth, new products, client experience, scale and efficiency, as well as artificial intelligence.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Record quarterly revenue combined with balanced expense management delivered adjusted pre-tax profit margin of 54.3%, as second quarter adjusted earnings per share reached a record $1.62, a year-over-year increase of 42%.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Demand for our secured lending solutions remained strong.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Led by new Pledged Asset Line originations, total bank loan balances grew to $67 billion, up 33% from 2Q 2025 and 16% versus the prior year-end, while investment securities remain relatively flat as we continue to support client lending needs.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Increased lending activity helps further deepen relationships with clients and drives relative improvements to both Schwab's revenue growth and mix as we earn an incremental spread to the security we'd otherwise purchase.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: While strong equity markets lifted sentiment and supported elevated trading activity, transactional sweep cash increased by $24.2 billion in 2Q, largely driven by demand for long-short strategies as well as organic asset gathering.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Beyond the growth related to long-short, client cash trends remain strong with year-to-date underlying cash performing better than our initial expectations coming into the year.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Our adjusted ratio of 6.8% reflects our support of business growth and client engagement, as well as the net redemption of preferred equity and the repurchase of $1 billion worth of common shares.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Looking ahead, we will continue to apply our consistent capital management framework, including prioritizing our resources to support client activity and the growth of our franchise.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Pivoting to the full-year 2026 scenario, let's take a moment to review how certain key assumptions have evolved over the first six months of the year.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: At the Investor Day back in May, we spoke to a scenario that reflected flat sub-funds for the year, stronger equity markets, and increased client trading activity.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: We also incorporated Forge's revenue and expenses following the acquisition's close in 1Q. While the impact of that acquisition is not material to the 2026 scenario, it does influence the revenue and expense year-over-year growth rates.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Our asset gathering momentum reinforces our confidence in the 5% organic growth rate we outlined for 2026.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Following another quarter of strong trading volumes, we have taken full-year daily average trades up to 10.6 million.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: This trading assumption does include a pullback from recent monthly levels, reflecting an expected moderation in activity, in part due to the seasonal slowdown during the summer.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Therefore, we would anticipate revenue per trade to increase modestly from 2Q26 levels as rate and volume tend to be inversely correlated.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Finally, today's updated scenario includes Forge, but excludes the impact from any opportunistic share repurchases during the second half of 2026.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Using these updates, we would expect total revenue growth of 17.5%-18.5% in 2026.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: With full-year net interest margin expanding to a range of 3.0%-3.10%, an average 4Q 2026 net interest margin expected to finish in the 3.25%-3.30% range as the timing of the potential Fed rate hike late in the year limits the impact in 2026.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Given our sustained business momentum, we now anticipate annual expense growth to range from 9.5%-10.5%.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Putting it all together, today's scenario implies stronger positive operating leverage and expanded adjusted pre-tax margin levels versus our prior scenarios.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Schwab's strong momentum and success over the past five decades has been driven by our focus on clients.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: As Rick noted upfront, we remain extremely well-positioned for the future with an expanding set of wealth and investing solutions to help clients meet their financial goals.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Which when combined with Schwab's leading scale, as well as our disciplined approach to expense and balance sheet management, helps reinforce our confidence in delivering mid-teen earnings growth through the cycle.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We remain bullish on NNA.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We really do see clients consolidating their financial life with investing being more at the center, and that puts us in a winning position.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: As I think about our three businesses, starting with Advisor Services, I think we continue to distance ourselves from competition in the marketplace.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We see NNA and TOA both accelerating.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: I expect that to drive more than 5% NNA growth, just as it has for the last several quarters.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We are investing in financial consultants and in AI.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We continue to invest in making sure our clients have coverage for having their needs met.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: That's an area where we could be doing more, where we have an opportunity to introduce ourselves to many working Americans for the first time.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: I believe we have an opportunity to grow our NNA there.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: All in all, I'm bullish on our NNA.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We remain positive about hitting 5% or higher and feel good about each of our three client-facing businesses in that regard.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We believe that the trading engagement you've seen is sustainable, and it's supported by broad client participation.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: I think there's been a structural shift in the amount of options trading that we'll see.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: AI has absolutely been a factor in our trading levels and will continue to drive trading as people use AI to both do research on how to position themselves and how to invest, as well as use AI in more of an algorithmic fashion to drive some of their trading.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: The fact that there's been AI, the Magnificent Seven, SpaceX more recently, all those things drive client interest, and not just in those areas, but more broadly in investing.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: I think you've seen a structural shift in people wanting to be engaged and wanting to invest: young investors, AI, all of that is leading towards a more sustained period of high levels of trading from our perspective.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: There was tremendous interest in SpaceX from our client base in participating in the IPO, and we obviously made as many shares available to them as we could get.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: We have seen tremendous growth this year as you noted.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Good expansion of that net interest margin, good engagement by our clients.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: We feel very good about that use of resources.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: We see value in returning capital in buybacks, we see even greater value of deploying those resources into the franchise like we've done this year.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: I think the last point of your question was around M&A. Again, we're growing organically very nicely.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Again, we always think about that organic growth and continuing to deploy resources to carry out the firm's strategy.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Keep in mind that we'll have to see how the rate path plays out.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: No, we feel good about the net interest margin expansion that we've seen so far.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: We think we are well positioned to see that continued margin expansion through the rest of the year and beyond.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Overall, we feel really good about the trajectory.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: You are seeing some repricing of the securities book, but it's at a much slower pace given the demand for lending activities.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: The expansion of the net interest margin is being driven by that lending activity and supported by our deposit base.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: I do think we've seen a particular surge as, if you look at the market dynamics, bigger competitors were maybe not making this as available, which probably led to a little bit of a surge.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Number one, as we look at the economics and look at the ROE, we find it to be accretive.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Number three, we think it's good for the RIA as a way to differentiate themselves from the client and bring a great wealth strategy to their clients.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Finally, it's great for our business because when we win the long-short business, not only do we win that business, we tend to win the business not only of the whole household, but we build the trust and confidence with the RIA.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: One of the reasons you've seen a nice acceleration in our RIA business is because we've been there, able to support them on this strategy as they've wanted to use it with their clients.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We are actively working with the Cboe on their rollout of binary options, but we haven't yet put out a timeline.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: The three elements to me are, one, that there's important information embedded in prediction markets about what's going to happen with employment, what's going to happen to inflation, what's the probability of a recession.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: I think it's completely disingenuous for people to be out in the market calling this an asset class and a new way for young people to invest.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: I think there are some benefits to tokenization and some real drawbacks, and it's unclear how much it's going to take off.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We're going to be excited to serve clients in whatever form they want.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: That includes the momentum in lending.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: That has been accelerating and has been even beyond what we had anticipated this year.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Rick covered wealth and managed investing, so those present enormous opportunities for us and are enabling us to not just grow revenue, but diversify revenue as well.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Back at Investor Day, we talked about the concept of diversification within net interest revenue, where more of the economics are being driven by lending, then outside of net interest revenue, including in areas like managed investing, of course, trading as well.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: We continue to invest in our industry-leading trading platform.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Those are areas over time that are going to contribute to revenue.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Those will continue to add over time to complement the very strong growth and diversification we already have underway.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Number two, we have clients that have large gains with big embedded capital gains.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: They have growing wealth, and they have concentrated positions, and they have a life they want to live.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: They're seeing their wealth grow, and they might want to buy a house, put their kid through college, whatever it may be, whatever they're spending money on.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: In terms of the securities, yes, we've seen good momentum in terms of that yield pickup.

signals.speaker: Mike Verdeschi
signals.sentence: Within the investment portfolio, we are seeing that yield shift.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: Schwab is clearly leading the industry today and is uniquely positioned to win tomorrow by seeing through clients' eyes and putting clients at the forefront of every decision.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We have earned our place at the trusted center of the investing ecosystem.

signals.speaker: Rick Wurster
signals.sentence: We are uniquely positioned to win in the long term with our strong momentum, no trade-offs value proposition, clear client-focused strategy, and diversified financial model.
